title: Split a Money amount by ratios without losing a cent
requirement: Add a method Money::allocate(array $ratios): array that splits a non-negative amount into one Money per ratio, in the same currency and in the same order as the ratios. Each part receives the floor of its proportional share in cents; the cents left over are then handed out one at a time to the parts in order, skipping parts whose ratio is zero, so the parts always add up exactly to the original amount (for example 10.00 split [1, 1, 1] gives 3.34, 3.33, 3.33). Ratios are non-negative integers. An empty ratio list, a negative ratio, or ratios that are all zero throw InvalidArgumentException. Money stays immutable.
